column1: # Macro-wall sweep at signal ceiling M5, all five dies, HBM-FORM-CONG-2 11-05 ~07:50 PST. ESTIMATE, read-only, advisory, moves nothing, claims no row. Kits of the last 7 days on intel1/intel2/epyc2/epyc4 with macro_placement.tcl or macro_place.tcl, one row per DESIGN_NAME. 220 macro designs read; kits at M6/M7 excluded (partitions, HEAD cores: M7, no wall by this read). Unread: kits whose macros have no parseable site. nkits = kits read for that design; the row shows the last congested kit, not necessarily the current form.

# WALL-MEAS: a kit at M5 ended with GRT overflow and >=50% of reported congested cells inside a macro box (congestion.rpt capped at 20000 rows) [CHECKED per row]. CONG-OTHER: M5 overflow, not mostly in macro boxes or no report. WALL-GEOM: no congestion read on the last kit, geometry only: a row >=60% blocked by macros and y gap <15 um [ESTIMATE]; S or over=0 shows geometry alone does not fail, it is a screen, not a prediction.

# open = in CORE-FORMS census open set 06:05. maxrow = worst horizontal cross-section share blocked. wallh = share of core height with >=50% blocked. so S = a kit of this design has a SIGNED/PASS signoff.json.
